name: optimiziramsi
description: optimiziramsi's Claude Code toolkit — one plugin per concern (git safety, commit style, reporting, sessions, lessons, instructions, guards, review, planning, todo, runners, patterns, worktrees, setup …); each project enables the ones it wants.

plugins.name: git-guard
plugins.description: Git safety net — a hook that blocks push/pull/fetch, bulk adds, non-FF merges, protected-branch moves, hard resets, --no-verify and discards of uncommitted work.

plugins.name: hotfix
plugins.description: Test-first hotfix for a deployed bug — reproduce as a failing test, minimal fix, land it on both the mainline and the release branch.

plugins.name: commit
plugins.description: House commit style — bare single-line messages, topic-close + pause-for-review cadence, safe staging; a commit-format guard and an end-of-session commit nudge.

plugins.name: code-first
plugins.description: Code-first working style — technical proposals are commits on an idea/<topic> branch the user reviews as a diff; an injected contract, a Stop guard on inline code, /idea to start, list, promote and drop ideas, and a stale-idea nudge.

plugins.name: rename
plugins.description: Move a file and cascade every reference to it across docs, skills and config.

plugins.name: reporting
plugins.description: Lean-reporting output contract, enforced — injected per prompt, re-pulsed every Nth tool call, and a Stop guard that blocks a narrating or over-long final message.

plugins.name: session
plugins.description: Session continuity — handoff (next-session notes, ≤4k), continue, session-summary, and a SessionStart state snapshot.

plugins.name: context
plugins.description: Context-window awareness — nudges at 30% / 50% / 60% of a 1M window (configurable), says plainly at the last one that a handoff is needed, honors 'remind me later' / 'keep going' / 'topic done', and /repack writes the handoff for a /clear → /continue refresh.

plugins.name: lessons
plugins.description: Learn once, keep it — retro harvests a session's learnings, lessons curates them in .agent/lessons/, and the lesson-scout agent finds prior art before you re-debug.

plugins.name: instructions
plugins.description: Keep the agent instruction system small and true — its rules (instructions-maintenance, rules-change), the instructions-audit sweep + auditor agent, and the caps / meta-lint size and structure checks.

plugins.name: guards
plugins.description: Project-owned enforcement — run your own .agent/guards.d checks on every shell command (tripwire-guard), and ask before the agent edits Claude settings or hook scripts (file-guard).

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Structured review — the review skill (P0/HIGH/MED/LOW → .agent/reviews/) plus semantic-bug, spec, doc-drift, multi-tenant isolation and wireframe reviewer agents.

plugins.name: qa-gate
plugins.description: The done-gate — typecheck, unit, e2e and visual verification before any claim of done.

plugins.name: planning
plugins.description: Plans and milestones — single-topic implementation plans in .agent/plan/, multi-session initiatives in .agent/milestone/.

plugins.name: todo
plugins.description: The .todo parking lot — triage-todo, feedback and scope-cut, plus a guard that keeps .todo the user's (arm with "ALLOW TODO").

plugins.name: runners
plugins.description: Unattended background work — looper / grind / collab prepare jobs that the shipped loop and grind runners execute as headless claude sessions, confined when run in a worktree.

plugins.name: patterns
plugins.description: Per-topic pattern registry under .agent/patterns/ — manage-patterns, pattern-compliance / pattern-verifier agents, and hooks that gate edits governed only by non-blessed patterns.

plugins.name: worktree
plugins.description: The parallel-work protocol — drive one topic on its own git worktree as review-gated slices, landing only on the human's OK. Pairs with worktree-guards.

plugins.name: worktree-guards
plugins.description: Guards that keep edits inside the active git worktree — write and shell guards, a leak detector, and a SessionStart worktree notice. No-ops outside a linked worktree.

plugins.name: setup
plugins.description: One-time bootstrap — scaffold the .agent/ workspace and write a house-style slim-router CLAUDE.md.

plugins.name: upkeep
plugins.description: Plugin upkeep — a session-start notice when an installed plugin has a newer version or a marketplace you use gained a plugin, a throttled background marketplace refresh, and /upkeep to apply updates and pick new plugins.
